name: getpeppr-docs-checks
description: Toolchain that compiles or parses every published example in this repository. It never calls the getpeppr API and consumes no secret; its only network request is an anonymous GET of the public OpenAPI spec.

scripts.check: npm run check:examples && npm run check:snippets && npm run check:python && npm run check:shell && npm run check:postman && npm run check:routes
